extraction_notes: Datasheet title is TP0610K; the requested ordering code TP0610K-T1-GE3 is listed on p. 1 as lead-free and halogen-free. The document identifies the device as Vishay Siliconix; top-level manufacturer follows the requested Vishay Intertech identity.
This is a p-channel device. Tabulated electrical values retain datasheet polarity. Typical-characteristics plots use positive magnitudes for VDS, VGS, ID, and IS, as shown by their axes.

The transfer, output, and capacitance figures on p. 3 were digitized at visible grid-aligned or curve-defined points. The transfer figure does not state VDS, and the capacitance figure does not state frequency; those omissions are preserved in the curve conditions.
Threshold voltage has no typical table value; only Min = -1 V and Max = -3 V are published at ID = -250 uA and VDS = VGS.

Published dynamic table values: Qg typ 1.7 nC, Qgs typ 0.26 nC, Qgd typ 0.46 nC at VDS = -30 V, VGS = -15 V, ID approximately -500 mA; turn-on time typ 20 ns and turn-off time typ 35 ns under the stated p. 2 conditions.

Published off-state limits: IDSS max = -25 uA at VDS = -60 V, VGS = 0 V, TA = 25 degC, and max = -250 uA at TJ = 85 degC. Published ID(on) minimums are -50 mA at VGS = -10 V, VDS = -4.5 V and -600 mA at VGS = -10 V, VDS = -10 V.
Only RthJA = 350 degC/W is published; RthJC is not provided. No trr or gate resistance value is published.
